headline: Building Permits Hit New Low, Occupancy Permits Near Ten-Year High; Presale Housing Supply and Demand Crosses, Oversupply in First Half
summary: Taiwan building permits in the first half totaled 50,723 units, down 28.2% year on year and the lowest for the period since 2018. Occupancy permits reached 68,225 units, near a ten-year high.
why: Building permits are a leading indicator of future housing supply and construction activity, which feed into the property market and related industries.
